locations.name: Tourist Service (Llafranc)
locations.description: The Llafranc waterfront activity hub, a ~4-minute walk from Mas Pastora — kayak and SUP rental (double kayak €30/1h, €50/2h; SUP €20/1h), a guided kayak-and-snorkel excursion (€50 pp, ~2.5 h, gear + underwater photos included, routes to El Golfet, Cala Pedrosa and the Tobacco Cave), private skippered boats (€175/1h to €475/4h for 2–5 guests) and a taxi boat — the elegant return leg for a one-way Tamariu hike. The single most useful contact of the chill-day menu: call after breakfast, decide by weather and energy. +34 696 02 72 03 · info@touristservice.es.
locations.address: Passeig de Cipsela, 1, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: The keystone of the choose-your-energy day: kayak/SUP walk-up rentals, the €50 guided kayak+snorkel (best adventure-to-effort ratio), €275 two-hour private boat, and taxi-boat returns. Save the number; call the morning of.
Published rates: kayaks (single €20/35/45, double €30/50/70 for 1/2/4 h), SUP €20/35/45, guided kayak+snorkel €50 pp ~2.5 h, private boat €175–475 (1–4 h).

locations.name: Can Mario Museum & Cork Museum
locations.description: Contemporary Catalan sculpture museum (Fundació Vila Casas) in a former cork factory in Palafrugell — ~220 works plus outdoor sculpture, with the Cork Museum and climbable Modernista water tower in the same complex (views over Palafrugell and the Empordanet). The designated cloudy-day pivot of the Costa Brava leg: summer schedule Wed–Sun 11:00–19:30, €10; ten minutes by car from Llafranc, pairs with lunch or shopping in town.
locations.address: Plaça de Can Mario, 7, 17200 Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: Cloudy-weather pivot: ~220 sculptures in a former cork factory, Wed–Sun 11:00–19:30 (open Thu Sep 10), €10; two-hour cultural break + Palafrugell lunch.
Official museum page: collection, hours and admission.

locations.name: Jetski Platja d'Aro
locations.description: Two-seat guided jet-ski tours (no license required) running caves-and-hidden-coast routes from Platja d'Aro — roughly a 30-minute drive from Llafranc. Per the chill-day note: not a spontaneous pivot — it needs an advance reservation and a fixed slot, so book ahead or skip in favor of the walk-up kayak options at Llafranc. +34 694 279 391.
locations.address: Passeig Marítim, 37, 17250 Platja d'Aro, Girona, Spain

references.note: Nearest verified jet-ski operator (none in Llafranc itself): ~30-min drive; guided two-seat tours, no license; confirm inventory and pricing at +34 694 279 391. Reserve ahead — not a same-day pivot.

locations.name: Lassdive (L'Estartit)
locations.description: Watersports operator on the L'Estartit seafront — license-free jet skis (from ~€90), flyboard, wakeboard and snorkeling near the Medes Islands marine reserve. A 35–45-minute drive from Llafranc, so per the chill-day note it's a reserve-ahead commitment rather than a spontaneous option; conveniently near Vinilo Wine Bar if a north-coast day materializes. WhatsApp +34 627 030 036.
locations.address: Passeig Marítim, s/n, 17258 L'Estartit, Girona, Spain

references.note: License-free jet skis from ~€90 plus flyboard/wakeboard/snorkeling; 35–45-min drive; WhatsApp +34 627 030 036. Reserve in advance — not a dependable same-day pivot.

locations.name: Triton Diving
locations.description: Dive-and-snorkel operator on Llafranc's Plaça dels Pins running boat tours to the best snorkeling reefs on this coast — spots reachable only by water; Poseidon in Calella is the equivalent operator one cove over. Operating since 1979 with 4.8/5 on both Google and TripAdvisor; the 2026 calendar lists boat-based beginner try-dives around €105 per person — a real adventure option for the chill day, but one to confirm a day or two ahead (schedule, medical requirements, duration), not improvise after breakfast.

locations.name: Cap Roig Botanical Gardens
locations.description: Cliff-top botanical gardens created in 1927 facing the Mediterranean — 20 hectares and ~800 species woven through contemporary sculpture, the castle of the eccentric Woevodsky couple and coastal viewpoints; the #1-rated attraction in Calella, with El Golfet cove directly below. Verified for the trip week: September weekdays 10:00–20:00 (last entry an hour before close), €7, full self-guided circuit ~1.5 hours — the best refined low-exertion outing of the Llafranc stay.
locations.address: Carrer Camí del Rus, s/n, 17210 Calella de Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: September weekday hours 10:00–20:00 (last entry 1 h before close), €7; ~1.5 h circuit; 20 ha, ~800 species, sculpture. Pairs with Calella or El Golfet; leave-open, no booking needed.
